properties.evidence: This idea presupposes the standing decision and is defined relative to it: a check-only pass writes nothing (so atomicity is untouched), and apply-valid is opt-in only (an explicitly chosen state, which is the standing rationale's own exception). If the all-or-nothing decision were ever reversed this idea would be moot, not wrong — so it DEPENDS_ON that decision standing. It addresses the iteration cost that decision's rationale acknowledges it creates; read apart it could be mistaken for a reversal, which it is not.
